How to use the Bonesaw - Phantom Blade Zero Weapon Guide
In this Fextralife video, I'm going to be showing you how I use the Bonesaw in Phantom Blade Zero, and this is a weird one, because I think most people, when they start using this weapon, are going to think that it's clunky and a bit slow compared to some of the other weapons. And I would say that the kill speed on trash mob seems to be a lot slower than some other weapons out there.

author: Fextralife
description:
How to use the Crescent Blade - Phantom Blade Zero Weapon Guide
In this Fextralife video, I'm going to be showing you guys how to use the Crescent Blade. This is an absolutely devastating weapon in Phantom Blade Zero. It probably has one of the highest attack power and stagger powers of all the weapons I've tested so far, and it's a pretty straightforward weapon to use. I would say the benefit of this weapon predominantly applies when you are killing trash mobs as opposed to boss fights, but it can still be useful in boss fights, and I'll show you how to use it in this video.
